children: Kochi Water Metro, a model for sustainable and eco-friendly public transport, has crossed the 8-million passenger mark since its launch on April 23, 2023, reflecting the growing popularity of the service.
With 224 daily trips across the Kochi backwaters, the water metro service has generated ₹30.24 crore revenue from ticket sales.

Officials of Kochi Metro Rail Ltd (KMRL) pointed out that even domestic and foreign tourists are increasingly using the service. The water metro has evolved into a model project, gaining recognition on international platforms, they said.

Meanwhile, work is underway for the addition of new terminals. While the terminals at Kadamakkudy and Paliyamthuruth have been readied, the one near Subhash Park is under construction. Work is set to begin soon on the terminals at Edakochi and Varapuzha.
Kochi Water Metro currently operates 20 boats. Three more boats, under construction at Cochin Shipyard, will be deployed — one in August 2027 and the other two by July 2028.

KMRL is also emerging as a key consultancy agency for water transport projects in other parts of the country and overseas, similar to the role played by Delhi Metro Rail Corporation in the metro rail sector.
It generated ₹15 crore revenue from consultancy projects last year.

The detailed project report (DPR) for a water metro in Mumbai has been finalised and submitted, while the DPR for Goa is under preparation. Feasibility reports for water metro projects in 18 locations across the country have been submitted to the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways.
The draft reports of feasibility studies at Chilika Lake and Kolab dam in Odisha, and a concept note for tourism development in Tripura have been submitted.
KMRL is currently preparing to undertake studies in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands and Uttarakhand. Pre-feasibility studies have been completed at Penang in Malaysia and Mekong river in Vietnam.
A pre-feasibility study also explored the possibility of introducing a water transport system in Ho Chi Minh City using its rivers and canals. Discussions are underway at the embassy level.

title: Kochi Water Metro hits 8-million passenger mark
